title: Proposal
description: A governed proposal: an intelligence runtime proposes a change; the host runtime validates it against this schema plus its own permission/authority closure, a human (or policy) approves, and only then is it applied — with an append-only audit trail. Runtime proposes; host validates, persists, and applies. `kind` is a host-defined discriminator and `payload` is an opaque, host-owned object: the substrate carries the governance envelope (origin, evidence, risk, status lifecycle) and leaves the domain-specific payload shape to the host, which selects and validates it by `kind`.

payload.description: Opaque, host-defined change description. The substrate does not constrain its shape; the host validates it against a domain schema selected by `kind`.
